s.note: Calitri's car crusher, waiting for Kip. Smashed beef, American cheese, pickles, onion.
s.how: Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce and mustard for the sauce. Roll the mince into 8 loose balls and season well with salt. Heat a heavy pan until smoking, add the balls, lay onion on each and smash flat with a spatula as hard as you can. Cook until the edges are dark and lacy, flip, add the cheese and cook a minute more. Butter and toast the buns, then build with sauce, pickles and a patty.

s.note: Otto's dog swallows the keys. Beef frank, slow chilli, melted cheddar, onion.
s.how: Brown the mince, breaking it up, then add the onion and garlic and cook until soft. Stir in the chilli powder and cumin, add the tomatoes and a splash of water, and simmer until thick. Grill the franks, turning, until blistered. Tuck them into the toasted rolls, spoon over the chilli and top with cheddar and raw onion.

s.note: They threw Calitri out of England and France. Chipotle fish, lime slaw, crema, corn tortillas.
s.how: Rub the fish with the chipotle, cumin, oil and salt. Toss the cabbage with the juice of one lime and a pinch of salt; mix the sour cream with a squeeze of lime. Sear the fish in a hot pan until it flakes, about 3 minutes a side, then break into chunks. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan, then fill with fish, slaw, crema and coriander, with lime wedges.
shop: 500g firm white fish fillets, such as flathead@Seafood

m.n: Heist night barbecue ribs with buttermilk slaw
m.note: Sphinx's one speech: I say poor us. Sticky pork ribs, smoky rub, crunchy slaw.
m.how: Mix the sugar, paprika, garlic powder, cayenne and 2 teaspoons of salt and rub all over the ribs. Wrap the racks tightly in foil and bake at 150C until the meat pulls back from the bones. Whisk the buttermilk, mayonnaise and a tablespoon of the vinegar, and toss with the cabbage and carrot. Mix the barbecue sauce with the rest of the vinegar, brush over the ribs and char on a hot barbecue or under the grill, basting, until sticky. Cut between the bones and serve with the slaw.

w.n: Sixty-second chocolate mug cakes with salted caramel
w.note: Eleanor is the unicorn says Donny. Molten middle, caramel, vanilla ice cream.
w.how: Whisk the flour, sugar and cocoa in a bowl, then beat in the eggs, milk and oil until smooth. Divide between 4 large microwave-safe mugs and push 2 squares of chocolate into the middle of each. Microwave each mug on high for about 60 seconds, until risen but still soft in the centre. Top each with a spoon of salted caramel and a scoop of ice cream and serve straight away.

d.n: Sway's michelada with Tecate and lime
d.note: Sway fixes cars by day, pours drinks by night. Lager, lime, hot sauce, salted rim.
d.how: Run a lime wedge round the rim of 4 glasses and dip in the chilli salt. Mix the tomato juice, the juice of 2 limes, the hot sauce and soy sauce. Fill the glasses with ice, add the tomato mix and top slowly with the cold beer.
